content.label: I don't say this lightly: Wispr Flow has changed how I work. Most of my use is dictating to generative AI tools, where I think out loud, change direction mid-sentence, and come back to refine. Flow handles all of it. It strips out my verbal tics, turns a stream of thought into something a model can work with, and makes the back-and-forth of iterating on a draft far faster than typing. It has also learned the names I use in my work, including the ones it used to get wrong, so I spend less time correcting and more time thinking. I use it for text messages and other apps too, but the AI work is where it has earned its keep. Highly recommend.
